ambient.description: Played in ambiance for this block

ambientBlockCount.description: Amount of nearby ambient sound blocks in order to reach full ambient sound volume

ambientMaxDistanceMerge.description: Adjacent ambient sound sources are merged to avoid playing too many sounds too loudly. This is the maximum distance a sound source can be from another to allow a merge.

ambientSoundType.description: The type of sound for this block's ambient sound.

break.description: Played when this block is broken.

byTool.description: Gets the sound that occurs when a specific tool hits a block. (Note for coders: if none specified in the JSON, this will be null from version 1.20.4 onwards)
